mechanism: Evidence key, fingerprint, and provenance arrays are independently filtered before positional pairing. Malformed or empty entries at different original indices can therefore be removed independently and compact surviving values into a synthetic aligned tuple that never existed as one evidence item.
risk: A quarantined branch could be reactivated by positional laundering: separately positioned novel key, content fingerprint, and provenance values may collapse into one apparent provenance-bound novelty tuple, creating false information gain and changing VAJRA routing.
requiredInvariant: Tuple alignment must be evaluated against original array positions. Invalid members must invalidate that position rather than compact arrays independently. Only one originally co-indexed, fully valid key/fingerprint/provenance tuple may qualify for quarantine reactivation.
promotionBoundary: Keep public state at verified v0.8 until an adversarial regression reproduces the laundering case, the core preserves positional identity, focused tests pass, and full cross-organ integration passes.
privacy: Synthetic de-identified fixtures only; no private connector content, names, IDs, or URLs are recorded.
